title: Project Artifact Created Event
description: A durable user-facing deliverable (diagram, chart, document, note, idea, BMAD artifact) of one pjangler project was captured into content-addressed storage and published for projection. The event carries references to the preserved bytes, never the bytes and never filesystem paths; see bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (project) and docs/project-artifact-sidecar.md.
$comment: Schema-first companion to the artifact-sidecar producer. Hygiene inherited from the project domain (§11.4): no credentials, no absolute filesystem paths anywhere in data, additionalProperties false at every level. The source bytes live in the sidecar's content-addressed store; data.artifact.sha256 and data.artifact.content.ref identify them (ref must equal 'sha256:' + sha256 — checked by assert_project_invariants). A render/source pair (e.g. mermaid text + rendered SVG) is ONE artifact: data.artifact carries the canonical form and data.artifact.render the rendered twin. Causation: envelope.causationid must equal data.origin.source_event.id, the id of the agent event whose bytes were captured (checked by assert_project_invariants).

ordering_key.description: §11.1 bucket project:<project_slug>; must equal 'project:' + data.project.slug (checked by assert_project_invariants).

project.description: The pjangler project the artifact belongs to, copied from its registry entry. Never guessed: attribution comes from the canonical pjangler registry or an explicit operator resolution of a held artifact.

artifact.description: The captured deliverable: stable id, revision, title, media type and the content-addressed reference to the preserved bytes.

origin.description: How the artifact was qualified and which agent event produced it: deterministic detection basis, qualification reason, source event identity, session context and creation time.

ref.description: Opaque content-addressed reference. NOT a filesystem path, NOT a URL; the projector resolves it against its configured store. Must equal 'sha256:' + the sibling sha256 field (checked by assert_project_invariants).

bytes.description: Size of the preserved bytes; at most 64 MiB.

artifact_id.description: Stable logical id: same id across revisions of the same deliverable, derived deterministically from the project slug and the project-relative logical path (uuid5).

revision.description: 1 for the first capture of this artifact_id; incremented when the same logical path is captured with different bytes. The same bytes at the same revision are idempotent, never re-published.

title.description: Human-facing title. The file basename for tool writes, a derived label for inline captures. Never an absolute path.

sha256.description: Digest of the canonical (source) bytes preserved before this event was published.

content.description: The canonical representation (source when a source/render pair exists).

render.description: Optional rendered twin of the same logical artifact at the same revision (e.g. an SVG rendered from a mermaid source). Present only when a real hook or renderer produced it; the sidecar never invents one.

detected_by.description: The service that qualified the artifact, e.g. artifact-sidecar.

basis.description: agent_tool_write: an agent.tool.completed whose arguments carried a file path plus full inline content. conversation_reply_mermaid: a fenced mermaid block extracted from a conversation.turn.completed reply_text. conversation_reply_delivered: substantial reply text the producer explicitly marked user-facing/delivered (data.delivered/user_facing truthy, or non-empty data.deliverables). project_activity_report: the rendered report of a bloodbank.project.activity.recorded event (markdown canonical, self-contained html as the render twin); the project comes from the event itself, never from a working directory, and source_event.type must be bloodbank.project.activity.recorded (checked by assert_project_invariants). operator_resolution: attribution was ambiguous and an operator mapped a held capture to its project.

qualification_reason.description: The deterministic reason this capture qualified (which adapter matched, which fields). No absolute paths.

id.description: Envelope id of the agent event whose bytes were captured. Must equal the envelope causationid (checked by assert_project_invariants).

created_at.description: When the artifact bytes were produced — the source event's time, not publication time.
